verdict.rationale: Shortwave's AI Assistant takes natural-language requests to read threads, write drafts, search email history and check the calendar. It can also run cross-app workflows through integrations and MCP, and users write custom filters in plain English to label, star and archive mail. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language command use, and explicit documentation that the assistant can perform the full range of inbox actions (send, archive, label) from chat rather than only reading and drafting.
